Twilight.text: This card is Neutral, but at the Reaping it scores 1 whichever side wins. At the end of the Day: If the other cards in your Choir hold as many Light cards as Dark cards (at least 1 each), gain 2 Glory.
Twilight.why: The in-between card scores like Nephilim, 1 on any won Day (V45): it measured 0.59 never scoring

Ordeal.text: On your turn: You may invoke this card, then discard it. At this Reaping, your Choir scores double; if it scores nothing, lose 2 Glory.
Ordeal.why: Spent (V45): as a Dark card that doubled every Day it measured 1.42

The Eclipse.text: In the Morning: Choose a Light or Dark card in your Choir. It counts as the other color this Day.
The Eclipse.why: Chosen in the Evening it measured 1.55 (V45): now a guess made before any card is played

The Whisper.text: In the Morning: Name Light or Dark aloud. If that side wins the Day, gain 2 Glory; if the other side wins, lose 2.

The Cantor.text: When you Offer, draw a card.
The Cantor.why: A pair of Offers for one action measured 0.72 to 0.77 (V45): the Cantor now makes the public good cheaper instead
